_comment: Hand-verified anchors for venues the geocoder mismatched or cannot know. City-level accuracy is the bar: the anchor feeds a rad=20 search, so being inside the right metro is what matters. Each entry names the ground truth used.

arenadabaixada.why: Ligga Arena (Arena da Baixada), Curitiba, Brazil - geocoder matched a street in Bahia named after it
